items.summary: Approved for bounded implementation by engineer. The change is isolated, reversible, and supported by current SEO evidence. Preserve factual content, indexability, navigation, and attribution boundaries. Do not infer revenue or profitability. Require focused tests, build success, exact changed-field documentation, and measurement after 14 days or 100 new impressions using available clicks, impressions, indexed status, and sessions.
